name: Misato Kanami
source:
The boss's wife, in her early 30s. She is a calm woman, and has a maternal instinct. 

A full-time housewife. She is naive and doesn't know to doubt people.

[From [url=http://www.r18game.com/gokuraku/joshibuka/kanami.html]official site[/url]]
